son-c1.chuyen_dong: The golden spirit eagle beats its swept-back wings powerfully, feathers ripple, the energy trail streams and flickers backward to the left, small leaves and feathers drift off the trail. The arrow stays in place (in-place flight loop).

son-c2.chuyen_dong: The rock shield-wall rises up a little from the ground with dust, the engraved sun star and Lac birds glow brighter in a slow pulse, floating pebbles orbit slowly. Loop.

son-c3.chuyen_dong: The lingzhi mushroom glows softly with a breathing pulse, green healing motes and sparkles rise continuously upward, leaves sway gently. Loop.

son-c4.chuyen_dong: The drill arrow tip spins fast around its own axis, violet-white vortex rings rotate and slide backward along the shaft, the cloud tunnel churns and swirls, sparks at the tip. In-place flight loop.

son-c5.chuyen_dong: Three arrows vibrate in flight, molten fire around them flows backward, broken rocks tumble and spin while drifting left and fading, glowing embers. In-place flight loop.

son-c6.chuyen_dong: The translucent golden-jade dome shimmers with a sweeping light reflection, engraved drum rings rotate slowly, the two golden Lac birds circle around the dome. Loop.

son-c7.chuyen_dong: Vines spiral upward around the sacred tree, flowers open, pink petals and fireflies float upward, emerald light rays pulse from the ring at its base. Loop.

son-c8.chuyen_dong: The bronze drum face pulses with light, concentric shockwave rings expand outward from it, lightning bolts crackle and re-form along the arrow, bright flash at the tip. Loop.

son-c9.chuyen_dong: Hundreds of golden arrows shimmer and jitter as a swarm, the giant Lac bird shape flaps its wings once per loop, jade leaves swirl in the trail, divine light pulses. In-place flight loop.

thuy-c1.chuyen_dong: The translucent water snake slithers and coils around the spear shaft, its head snaps forward beside the tip, water ribbons stream backward, bubbles drift off. In-place flight loop.

thuy-c2.chuyen_dong: Crystal water falls continuously down the shield-shaped curtain, the sun star in the center pulses with light, droplets and bubbles rise, waves at the base ripple. Loop.

thuy-c3.chuyen_dong: The clam shell opens slightly wider, the luminous pearl glows brighter in a breathing pulse, sparkling bubbles rise, water ribbons sway. Loop.

thuy-c4.chuyen_dong: The spear spins on its axis, curling wave rings rotate and slide backward along the shaft like a vortex tunnel, foam sprays, violet glints. In-place flight loop.

thuy-c5.chuyen_dong: Three silver spears glide on a crashing white-foam wave, the wave rolls and breaks continuously, spray and droplets fly backward. In-place flight loop.

thuy-c6.chuyen_dong: Light sweeps across the serpent-scale dome, scales shimmer one row after another, the water serpent on top slowly turns its head, base waves ripple. Loop.

thuy-c7.chuyen_dong: The little waterfall pours continuously, the pool ripples in rings, the pink lotus opens and glows, petals and bubbles float upward with aqua light. Loop.

thuy-c8.chuyen_dong: The water serpent writhes around the lightning spear and roars, blue-violet bolts crackle and re-form along the trail, flashes at the spear tip. In-place flight loop.

thuy-c9.chuyen_dong: The huge tidal wave rolls forward and curls, foam churns at its crest, the silver spears inside shimmer, the giant water serpent head roars and sways, pearls glint. In-place loop.
